scope: relay-fastapi PostgreSQL login proposed as obsidian_relay

postgresObservation.measurement: read-only pg_settings, pg_stat_activity and pg_roles queries

evidence: relay-fastapi/main.py sets the loop default ThreadPoolExecutor to at most 8
repository factories create one short-lived connection per method and expose no pool

decision.reason: Nine connections cover the enforced one-process runtime maximum; three additional slots permit bounded diagnosis/recovery without making concurrency unbounded.

invariants: ALTER ROLE obsidian_relay CONNECTION LIMIT 12 is rehearsal-only until separately authorized
no PgBouncer or implicit client pool is assumed
all repository connections close at method exit
a second process or Uvicorn worker requires a new budget
ordinary PostgreSQL capacity must remain at least twice the proposed role limit
stopConditions: active relay process count is not exactly one
Uvicorn workers per process is not exactly one
repository method can retain or nest more than one PostgreSQL connection
connection denial, ambiguous transaction, or outbox backlog appears during rehearsal
rollback: The bound is additive and not deployed. During a later authorized rollout, stop relay-fastapi before restoring its prior credential or role limit; reconcile ambiguous money/outbox state before restart.
nextPrerequisite: rehearse the eight R5 transition writer bodies with concurrency, denial and fault rollback
